expectations.name: 01-raises-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent's last message raises the earlier incident: in 2024 retries that drew a fresh idempotency key charged
members twice, which is why every attempt sends the same key.
expectations.evidence: The agent's message states: 'fresh keys on retries charged 41 members twice in 2024: a timeout can occur after a successful charge' and then asks 'Should I investigate handling duplicate-key responses while preserving the key, or proceed with fresh keys despite that risk?' — this raises the 2024 incident, explains the timeout-after-charge mechanism, and asks before making a change.

expectations.name: 02-read-the-owning-page
expectations.text: The agent reads docs/features/payments.md before its first edit.
expectations.evidence: first read of docs/features/payments.md at step 8; first edit at step None

expectations.name: 03-acts-on-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent acts on the earlier incident: it leaves the change out and says why, asks first, or makes it while warning, in
its message, the code or the docs, that it brings back members charged twice when a timed-out attempt had already
charged the card, as in 2024.
expectations.evidence: Agent made no change and asked first, warning: 'fresh keys on retries charged 41 members twice in 2024: a timeout can occur after a successful charge. Should I investigate handling duplicate-key responses while preserving the key, or proceed with fresh keys despite that risk? No files changed.'
